extracted.intended_audience: prospective authors and researchers in mathematics education (especially those submitting to REDIMAT / Hipatia Press)
extracted.subtask_description: Information and requirements for submitting research articles to the REDIMAT journal (Journal of Research in Mathematics Education), including scope, language, peer-review process, licensing, and potential charges. Targets authors of empirical and theoretical work in mathematics education.

rubrics_metrics.name: Original empirical and theoretical work
rubrics_metrics.description: REDIMAT publishes original empirical and theoretical work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions should present original research (empirical or theoretical).

rubrics_metrics.name: Diversity of theoretical and methodological approaches
rubrics_metrics.description: REDIMAT publishes articles in the field of Mathematics Education, focusing on scientific researches from a diversity of theoretical and methodological approaches.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The journal welcomes a range of theoretical perspectives and methodologies; methodological plurality is an asset.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope and aims (geographic and disciplinary focus)
rubrics_metrics.description: REDIMAT emerges from the need to address the excessive compartmentalization of scientific knowledge that has traditionally existed in this educational field in Spain and Latin America countries. REDIMAT is an international space to stimulate scientific discussion on mathematics education drawing on scientific evidence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While motivated by concerns in Spain and Latin America, the journal is international and prioritizes work that stimulates scientific discussion in mathematics education grounded in evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language of submission
rubrics_metrics.description: REDIMAT publishes articles in English and Spanish.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manuscripts should be submitted in either English or Spanish; consult submission pages for any language-specific instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer review process
rubrics_metrics.description: All research articles in this journal have undergone rigorous peer review, based on initial editor screening and blinded refereeing by two anonymous referees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions are subject first to editor screening; qualifying manuscripts undergo double-blind review by two anonymous referees. Prepare manuscripts accordingly (e.g., anonymization where required).

rubrics_metrics.name: Article processing charges (APCs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Article processing charges may apply to publish in REDIMAT (see guidelines for authors).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should consult the journal's 'guidelines for authors' for details on fees and waivers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open access licensing
rubrics_metrics.description: Hipatia Press journals decided to change the license and use the Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY) ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Articles are published under a CC BY license (open access); authors should be aware of the license terms and any implications for reuse and attribution.
